module: Unit tests of routeManager (resolution of relative route names, relative back targets, default value of `uiNav`). Game test file, of no direct interest to a modder except as usage examples of resolveRouteName and getRoute. Run with: extensions.testFramework_TestManager:runTestFiles("routeManager"). The file also contains, in a comment, a manual relative navigation test (ui_router.navigate("./options:options-search") from "pause" must give name = "pause.options").
notes: Each testXxx(ctx) function is a test function run by testFramework_TestManager; the game does not call them outside tests.

testAbsoluteReferenceUnchanged.desc: An absolute dotted reference ("pause.options") passes through unchanged.

testAbsoluteGlobalReferencesUnchanged.desc: Single-segment global references ("play") and '/'-prefixed ones ("/mainmenu") stay absolute, even without a base route.

testRelativeIdempotentAfterResolution.desc: An already resolved canonical name ("pause.options") stays identical if resolved again (stability on reload).

testRelativeWithoutBaseFails.desc: A relative reference without a base route (nil or empty string) fails with "relative_route_without_base".

testRelativeAboveRootFails.desc: Going above the root fails ("../../options" or ".." from "pause" give "invalid_relative_route").

testInvalidReferenceFails.desc: An empty or nil reference fails with "invalid_relative_route".

testRelativeBackTargetResolvesToParent.desc: With temporary routes (registerModRoutes then unregisterModRoutes), a relative `backTarget` ".." is resolved against the route that declares it.

testRelativeFallbackTargetResolves.desc: A relative `fallbackTarget` is resolved the same way.

testUiNavDefaultsToTrueWhenOmitted.desc: `ui.uiNav` is true when the route does not define it.

testUiNavExplicitFalseSurvivesInheritanc.desc: An explicit `ui.uiNav = false` is not overwritten by default value inheritance.

testUiNavStaticPlayOptOut.desc: The static route "play" has uiNav = false (UI navigation disabled).

testUiNavStaticMultiseatOptOut.desc: The static route "multiseat" has uiNav = false.

testAbstractParentRelativeBackTargetUses.desc: The relative `backTarget` of an abstract parent is resolved against that parent.
